prompts.prompt: What hash algorithm does Suricata use to name files saved through its file-extraction feature, enabling automated malware hash lookups? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/security/skills/suricata/SKILL.md - File Extraction section: Files are stored with SHA256 hashes as filenames, enabling automated malware hash lookups.
